How to play

Hold and drag on the ground to walk your farmer around.

Just walk onto a field to pick its crops. Step onto the soil and your farmer harvests whatever is ready.

Walk up to a woolly sheep and tap it to shear it.

Tap a job at the top and the view flies to it.

Stand close to something to make its button appear.

Tap that glowing button to buy or improve it.
